headline: WOMAN PILOTS HORSELESS CARRIAGE 66 MILES IN DARING CROSS-COUNTRY DRIVE
dispatch: Bertha Benz, wife of inventor Karl Benz, completed a remarkable 106-kilometre journey from Mannheim to Pforzheim yesterday in a Benz Patent-Motorwagen, marking the first long-distance automobile trip ever attempted. She set off before dawn without informing her husband, taking their two sons as passengers. The journey proved the practical road-worthiness of the motorwagen and drew crowds of astonished onlookers at every village along the route.
answer: Bertha Benz drives first long-distance auto trip, 1888
